processModel.name: Permit Application Process
processModel.description: Linear permit application from intake through closure. Progress Plan execution on case is out of scope for this draft.

activities.name: Receive application
activities.description: Register incoming permit application on the case.

activities.name: Completeness check
activities.description: Verify application package is complete before technical assessment.

activities.name: Technical assessment
activities.description: Evaluate permit request against technical criteria.

activities.name: Decision recording
activities.description: Record permit decision outcome on the case.

activities.name: Close case
activities.description: Close the permit case after notification.

metadata.sourcePrompt: Permit application: receive, completeness check, technical assessment, decision, notify, close. Deadlines at assessment and decision.

annotations.note: Regulatory deadline applies to completeness check and technical assessment.
Decision must be recorded within configured decision deadline.
